name: canvas-text
blurb: Text filled with animated wavy colored lines that pulse and curve continuously.
description: Renders text on canvas with horizontal wavy lines drawn inside the text boundaries. Lines animate with sine-wave motion and cycle through multiple colors. Responsive to theme changes.
use_when: A display heading wants a dynamic, painterly effect with animated line art inside the letterforms.
avoid_when: When text must be selectable or when canvas rendering is restricted.
a11y: Text is rendered on canvas with aria-label; not selectable by users.
